含玩家、坐标或时间变量的表达式会逐帧读取。只有随机数的表达式沿用固定取样；“重新: Expressions containing player, coordinate or time variables are evaluated every frame. Random-only expressions keep one sample; Reroll changes those samples.
变量：player.x / player.y、x / y（当前物件）、x1 /: Variables: player.x / player.y, x / y (this object), x1 / y1 / x2 / y2 (current endpoints), frame (absolute frame), time (seconds), age (frames alive), direction, speed, fps, pi. Directions use degrees; sin / cos use radians.

发射角度只影响新弹幕；这里控制已经发射的每颗弹幕。预览追踪参考玩家，游戏中追踪真: The emission angle affects newly spawned bullets. These controls steer each bullet during flight. Preview uses the reference player; games use the real player.
每帧执行，x/y 为这颗弹幕的位置，direction 为上一帧方向。示例：tu: Runs every frame. x/y are this bullet’s position; direction is its previous direction. Example: turn_towards(direction,point_direction(x,y,player.x,player.y),3)
编辑预览中的 player.x/y；也可在画布上勾选“编辑试玩玩家”后拖动。原生: Preview player.x/y. Enable Edit test player on the canvas to drag this reference. Imported projects also use it as the F5 test position.
左键点击或拖动设置表达式预览的参考玩家位置，Shift 按 16 像素吸附；工程: Click or drag the reference player for expression preview. Shift snaps to 16 pixels; enter X/Y in Project settings. Imported projects also use it for F5. The native film keeps its recorded player position.

在渲染拉镜时镜像延伸房间边缘，避免甩镜或旋转时露出黑边。: Mirror the room edges while rendering the camera to fill the frame during pans and rotations.
效果透明度控制整套冲击；缩放、色散、残像和闪光可分别调整。: Effect opacity controls the whole impact. Zoom, RGB split, echoes and flash can be adjusted independently.
强度控制错位距离；透明度控制整套故障。顿帧只影响画面，游戏逻辑继续执行。: Strength controls displacement; opacity controls the whole glitch. Stutter affects the image while game logic continues.
时间从每颗弹幕出生的第 0 帧开始。拖动条块移动，拖右边界改时长；同属性重叠时，: Time starts at each bullet’s birth. Drag blocks to move; drag the right edge to resize. Later actions take priority on overlapping properties.
沿闭合轮廓参数排列；角度控制沿线相位，轮廓朝向控制整体旋转。星星/花朵使用边数设: Sample along the closed outline. Angle sets the phase along it; outline rotation turns the whole shape. Sides sets the number of star points or flower petals.
请先选中物件、整体对象、发射器或分组。: Select an object, formation, emitter or group first.
已应用物件生成行为；模板从自己的起点独立运行。: Object spawning applied. Each template runs independently from its own start.
开启后不在歌曲时间轴自行出现，仍可被其他物件生成。模板的关键帧与运动保留。: Hide this object from automatic timeline playback while allowing others to spawn it. Its motion and keyframes are retained.
时间从物件开始计算；模板生成后从自己的时间起点运行，关键帧与运动独立。: Times are relative to the source object’s start. Each spawned template starts its own clock for keyframes and motion.
请选择有效的生成模板。可先在时间轴制作物件或分组，并勾选“仅用作生成模板”。: Choose a valid template. Create an object or group on the timeline and enable “Template only”.
重复时，持续帧数 0 表示直到母体结束；大于 0 表示触发窗口。开始年龄和每颗延: For repetition, duration 0 continues until the source ends; a positive duration limits the trigger window. Start age and per-bullet delay still apply.
原物件为第 0 代。生成物可继续生成下一代，最大 4 代。: The original source is generation 0. Spawned templates may create further generations, up to 4.
生成物以当前位置为起点，从模板自己的开始帧执行关键帧和运动；生成后独立存在。整体: Spawn at the source position and play the template’s keyframes and motion from its own start. Children survive independently. Center mode destroys the whole source; member mode destroys only matching bullets.

变量：source.x / source.y（生成时来源中心世界坐标）、play: Variables: source.x / source.y (source center in world coordinates at generation), player.x / player.y, x / y (current object), x1 / y1 / x2 / y2, frame, time, age, direction, speed, fps, pi, i (zero-based index), n (count), u (0–1 position), volley. Directions use degrees; sin / cos use radians.
在行为生效期间执行。x/y 是本弹幕位置；source.x/y 是生成时来源中心: Runs while this behavior is active. x/y is this bullet position; source.x/y is a snapshot of the source center in world coordinates at generation. Also supports i, n, u, volley, age, player.x/y, speed and direction. sin/cos use radians.
用于发射后的弹幕与释放后的成员。出屏幕按房间边界；出视野按游戏镜头。边界按弹幕中: Applies to fired bullets and released formation members. Room bounds and the current game camera are separate modes. Tests the bullet center; spawning outside also triggers removal.
正值放宽边界；负值提前在范围内触发，可让销毁过渡在画面内可见。出界模式不受固定寿: Positive values expand the boundary; negative values trigger inside it so the transition stays visible. Boundary modes ignore the fixed lifespan.
固定寿命在结束前播放过渡；出界或销毁行为触发后播放过渡，结束才移除。触发销毁后不: Fixed lifespan transitions run before expiry. Boundary exits and destroy actions start a transition before removal. Once destruction is triggered, collision and further spawning stop.
方向 = 初始生成方向 + 成员编号 × 递增值；开启继承时再叠加母体方向。编号: Direction = initial spawn direction + member index × increment, plus the parent direction when inheritance is enabled. Indices start at 0.
保存发射瞬间母弹的贴图、颜色与彩虹帧，新弹后续不会跟着变色。运动仍使用模板。: Capture the source sprite, tint and rainbow frame at emission. The child keeps those colors while its template controls motion.
按母体当前大小替换模板起始大小；模板后续的缩放动画继续按比例执行。: Match the source size at birth; later template scaling remains proportional.
关闭时同一波弹幕使用相同颜色；开启时逐颗取样。支持固定种子和重新随机。: Off: one shared color per wave. On: sample each bullet. Fixed seeds and resampling are supported.
原物件开始帧 + 开始年龄。逐成员延迟继续叠加；仅作模板时此处为局部参考时钟，实: Source start plus trigger age. Per-member delays are added. Template-only objects use a local reference clock shifted to their actual spawn time.
模板内生成：随实例的局部时钟执行: Template spawning follows each instance local clock
生成触发位置（歌曲时间）：单击定位；双击编辑此规则。逐成员延迟与重复均已计入。: Scheduled spawn times: click to seek; double-click to edit this rule. Includes repeats and per-member delays.
random(360) 随机色相；choose(0,120,240) 选择色相；: random(360) selects a hue; choose(0,120,240) selects among hues; choose("#FF75AD","#6DE8FF") selects explicit colors. Sampled at birth and then held. Use a white sprite for arbitrary tinting; rainbow sprites retain their own colors.
random(360) 或 choose(\"#FF75AD\",\"#6DE8: Use random(360) or choose("#FF75AD","#6DE8FF"). Members share a color per round, fixed after birth. Overrides inherited tint; use a white template sprite for arbitrary colors.
单击编辑模板参数；双击展开模板关键帧并切到局部起点。共用模板的修改会影响所有引用: Click to edit template parameters; double-click to expand its keys and seek to its local start. Changes to a shared template affect every reference.
